description: This file is a header file (.h) defining data structures, function prototypes for setup, teardown, and various test cases related to scheduled download functionality in a TR-069 manager plugin.

methods.name: test_scheduledownload_setup
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, sets up necessary preconditions for scheduled download tests.

methods.name: test_scheduledownload_teardown
methods.description: Cleans up after tests, releasing resources used during scheduled download testing.

methods.name: test_scheduledownload_basic_start_stop
methods.description: Tests starting and stopping the scheduled download process.

methods.name: test_scheduledownload_ok_rpc_call
methods.description: Verifies that a correct RPC call for scheduled download behaves as expected.

methods.name: test_scheduledownload_nok_1_rpc_call
methods.description: Tests error handling for a specific failed RPC call scenario.

methods.name: test_scheduledownload_nok_2_rpc_call
methods.description: Tests error handling for another RPC failure scenario.

methods.name: test_scheduledownload_nok_3_rpc_call
methods.description: Tests error handling for a third RPC failure scenario.

methods.name: test_scheduledownload_nok_4_rpc_call
methods.description: Tests error handling for a fourth RPC failure scenario.

methods.name: test_scheduledownload_nok_ok_rpc_call
methods.description: Tests mixed success and failure in RPC calls for scheduled download.

methods.name: test_scheduledownload_start_stop_nok_pending_upgrade
methods.description: Tests starting/stopping scheduled download when a pending upgrade exists, expecting failure.

methods.name: test_scheduledownload_start_stop_ok_pending_upgrade
methods.description: Tests starting/stopping scheduled download when a pending upgrade exists, expecting success.
